name: paperproof
description: PaperProof (CiteVerify) — Scientific Claim and Citation Verification System (INNOVEDGE Hackathon 2026)

scripts.dev: node -e "const path=require('path'); const {spawn}=require('child_process'); const py=path.resolve('backend', process.platform==='win32'?'.venv/Scripts/uvicorn.exe':'.venv/bin/uvicorn'); const b=spawn(py,['app.main:app','--port','8000'],{cwd:'backend',stdio:'inherit'}); const f=spawn(process.platform==='win32'?'npm.cmd':'npm',['run','dev'],{cwd:'frontend',stdio:'inherit'}); process.on('SIGINT',()=>{b.kill();f.kill();process.exit();});"
